summary: This Form 8-K reports AXT Inc.'s entry into a Master Development and Supply Agreement with Coherent Corp for 6-inch indium phosphide wafer substrates. AXT receives a $22.3 million prepayment to expand manufacturing capacity in Beijing, with a three-year term and committed capacity. The transaction is a routine supply agreement with standard commercial terms, not a special situation. The prepayment is refundable unless Coherent fails minimum orders. No ownership change, board recommendation, or deal mechanics typical of acquisitions, divestitures, or restructuring are present. This filing does not reflect any special-situation corporate event.
